scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dynamo:migrate-legacy: cd packages/nextjs && NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./scripts/server-only-shim.cjs' env-cmd --file ../../.env -- npx tsx scripts/migrate-legacy-dynamo-to-app.ts
scripts.dynamo:init: npm run dynamo:start && npm run dynamo:create-table
scripts.dynamo:remove: cd packages/local/docker-dynamodb && env-cmd --file ../../../.env -- docker compose down -v
scripts.dynamo:start: cd packages/local/docker-dynamodb && env-cmd --file ../../../.env -- docker compose up -d
scripts.dynamo:stop: cd packages/local/docker-dynamodb && env-cmd --file ../../../.env -- docker compose stop
scripts.harness:civitas: cd packages/nextjs && NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./scripts/server-only-shim.cjs' env-cmd --file ../../.env -- npx tsx scripts/civitas-demo-stress-harness.ts
scripts.harness:civitas:moral: cd packages/nextjs && NODE_OPTIONS='--require ./scripts/server-only-shim.cjs' env-cmd --file ../../.env -- npx tsx scripts/civitas-moral-coding.ts
